label: entity-core peer
info:
The entity-core core-protocol peer, AUTHORED as a flow-graph.

Every wire carries CBOR frame BYTES — exactly what the TCP wire carries (Node-RED clones msg, so class instances can't cross wires; this is the faithful consequence). The per-dispatch state (decoded Execute, capability token, resolution) lives in the session scratch, keyed by msg.did — never on the wire.

The §6.5 dispatch chain is DECOMPOSED into visible nodes (row 2): begin (decode+target §1.4) → connect-preauth (§4.2) → author present (401) → capability present (403) → verify (§5.2) → resolve (§6.6, 404) → permission (§5.2/§6.8, 403) → handler. Each node's error wire (down) runs to build-error; the tail encodes and returns to transport. The wires ARE the §6.5 sequence.

DELEGATED (kernel.prim, called from inside the nodes): canonical CBOR, Ed25519 verify, SHA-256, the capability-chain verdict, the permission verdict — the mechanical/crypto 'libraries'. The SEQUENCE around them is authored graph.

ADR-0012: a green result here is cohort-consistent (shared JS substrate + shared leaf crypto), not independent convergence.
